searchText: Yes. Some clarity on this in the EIP document is required. So, if I understand it correctly, we don't allow delegations to pre-compiles in the first place. These are valid i.e. not rejected, however if you try to run the delegated account it wont run any code (just like if you point a 7702 address to an empty account / account with no code) yeah it allows them, the address just will have leading 0s exactly, it isn’t prohibited, it just returns empty code
